answer: Admission runs through a jetty: each epoch admits one newcomer per 200 tasks verified honest last epoch. First, the applicant posts a $20 bond and a work sample. Second, two incumbents re-run the sample; a mismatch slashes the bond and bars the applicant for three epochs. Third, the newcomer completes five supervised tasks, each co-signed by a mentor risking a $50 stake per failed check. Forging 100 identities needs 20,000 tasks at $0.10 ($2,000) plus $2,000 in bonds. Like a jetty narrowing the ocean's tide into one channel, the valve turns a flood into a countable trickle.
